title: Texture-cache state tracker skips the barrier between two storage-image dispatches because layout and access mask are unchanged
expected_finding: guest_cs_fill writes guest_storage_image (GENERAL, SHADER_WRITE) and guest_cs_smooth then reads and writes it, but the tracker emits no barrier between the dispatches since the requested state (GENERAL, SHADER_READ | SHADER_WRITE) equals the tracked one: read-after-write and write-after-write between the two dispatches
